```{r data-loading, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
# All data comes from CSVs produced by dataanalysis.R
wpop_df <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_pop_density_pixels.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) tibble())

pop_longitude <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_pop_benchmark.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) tibble())

density <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_density_benchmark.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) tibble())

pop_growth <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_pop_growth.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) tibble())
```

### Population Growth

```{r population-growth, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-population-growth
#| results: asis

if (nrow(pop_growth) > 0 && "Year" %in% names(pop_growth)) {
  pop_min_year <- min(pop_growth$Year)
  pop_max_year <- max(pop_growth$Year)

  # Detect if we have multiple sources (G1 + G2)
  has_source <- "Source" %in% names(pop_growth)
  sources <- if (has_source) unique(pop_growth$Source) else "WorldPop"
  multi_source <- has_source && length(sources) > 1

  source_colors <- c("WorldPop Global 1" = "#4292C6", "WorldPop Global 2" = "#08306B")
  source_linetypes <- c("WorldPop Global 1" = "dashed", "WorldPop Global 2" = "solid")

  pop_growth_plot <- ggplot(pop_growth,
    aes(x = Year, y = Population,
        group = if (multi_source) Source else Location,
        color = if (multi_source) Source else NULL,
        linetype = if (multi_source) Source else NULL)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = if (pop_max_year - pop_min_year > 15)
        seq(floor(pop_min_year/5)*5, ceiling(pop_max_year/5)*5, by = 5)
      else
        seq(floor(pop_min_year/2)*2, ceiling(pop_max_year/2)*2, by = 2),
      minor_breaks = seq(pop_min_year, pop_max_year, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(pop_growth$Population)),
      labels = scales::label_comma(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
      expand = expansion(c(0, .1))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste0(city, " Population Growth, ", pop_min_year, "-", pop_max_year),
         x = "", color = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = .125, color = "dark gray"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = .125, linetype = 2, color = "dark gray"),
      legend.position = if (multi_source) "bottom" else "none")

  if (multi_source) {
    pop_growth_plot <- pop_growth_plot +
      scale_color_manual(values = source_colors) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = source_linetypes)
  }

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "oxford-pop-growth.png"), plot = pop_growth_plot, device = "png",
         width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  ggplot2:::print.ggplot(pop_growth_plot)

  pop_growth_summary <- pop_growth %>%
    arrange(Year) %>%
    summarize(.by = c(Location, Source),
      year_1 = head(Year, 1),
      pop_1 = head(Population, 1),
      year_last = tail(Year, 1),
      pop_last = tail(Population, 1),
      span = year_last - year_1,
      change = pop_last - pop_1,
      change_pct = scales::percent(pop_last/pop_1 - 1, accuracy = 0.1),
      growth_rate = scales::percent((pop_last/pop_1)^(1/span) - 1,  accuracy = 0.1))

  print_paged_df(pop_growth_summary)

  pmap(pop_growth_summary, \(...) {
    row <- tibble(...)
    src_label <- if (multi_source) paste0(" (", row$Source, ")") else ""
    print_text(glue("{paste_bold(row$Location)}{src_label}'s population grew by {paste_bold(row$change_pct)} from {paste_bold(scales::comma(row$pop_1))} in {paste_bold(row$year_1)} to {paste_bold(scales::comma(row$pop_last))} in {paste_bold(row$year_last)} for an average annual growth rate of {paste_bold(scales::percent(((row$pop_last/row$pop_1)^(1/(row$year_last-row$year_1)) - 1), accuracy = 0.1))}"))
  })

  print_text(paste0(paste_bold("Yearly population"), " - sorted by absolute growth"))

  pop_growth %>% select(Year, Population, Location, Country, Group, Source) %>%
    group_by(Source) %>%
    mutate(growth = Population - lag(Population)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Source, desc(growth)) %>%
    print_paged_df()

  print_text(paste0(paste_bold("Yearly population"), " - sorted by percentage growth"))

  pop_growth %>% select(Year, Population, Location, Country, Group, Source) %>%
    group_by(Source) %>%
    mutate(growth_pct = (Population - lag(Population))/lag(Population)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Source, desc(growth_pct)) %>%
    print_paged_df()
}
```

### WorldPop Global 1 (2000-2020)

```{r population-growth-g1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-population-growth-g1
#| results: asis

pop_g1 <- pop_growth %>% filter(Source == "WorldPop Global 1")
if (nrow(pop_g1) > 0) {
  g1_plot <- ggplot(pop_g1, aes(x = Year, y = Population)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2020, 5), minor_breaks = seq(2000, 2020, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(pop_g1$Population)),
      labels = scales::label_comma(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
      expand = expansion(c(0, .1))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste0(city, " — WorldPop Global 1 (1km, UN-adjusted)"),
         subtitle = "2000–2020", x = "", y = "Population") +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = .125, color = "dark gray"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = .125, linetype = 2, color = "dark gray"))

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "worldpop-g1-growth.png"), plot = g1_plot, device = "png",
         width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  ggplot2:::print.ggplot(g1_plot)

  print_paged_df(pop_g1 %>% select(Year, Population))
}
```

### Population Density Distribution

```{r chart-worldpop-density-ridge, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-worldpop-density-ridge

if (nrow(wpop_df) > 0) {
  librarian::shelf(ggridges)

  # Calculate x-axis limit (cap at 99th percentile)
  x_max <- quantile(wpop_df$pop, 0.99)

  # Create ridge plot with quantile coloring
  p_density <- wpop_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = pop, y = 1, fill = factor(after_stat(quantile)) )) +
    stat_density_ridges(
      geom = "density_ridges_gradient",
      calc_ecdf = TRUE,
      quantiles = 1:4/5,
      quantile_lines = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.6,
      scale = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, x_max),
      breaks = seq(0, ceiling(x_max/10)*10, by = max(10, ceiling(x_max/100)*10)),
      minor_breaks = seq(0, ceiling(x_max/10)*10, by = max(5, ceiling(x_max/200)*10))
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Percentile",
      values = c('#ECEB72', '#D4BE62', '#BD9252', '#A56542', '#8E3933'),
      labels = c("0-20th", "20-40th", "40-60th", "60-80th", "80-100th")
    ) +
    labs(x = "Population density (people/hectare)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = .125, color = "dark gray"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "population_density_distribution.png"),
         plot = p_density, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  p_density
}
```

### Population Density

```{r population-density, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-population-density
#| results: asis

if (nrow(density) > 0 && any(!is.na(density$Density))) {
  hues <- c("black", "dark grey") %>%
    setNames(c(city, "Benchmark"))
  hues[1] <- "#000000"

  density_plot <- density %>%
    filter(!is.na(Density)) %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_point(aes(x = Population, y = Density, color = Group)) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      aes(x = Population, y = Density, label = Location, color = Group),
      box.padding = 0.25, min.segment.length = 0.001, point.padding = 1,
      segment.linetype = "dotted") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = .125, color = "dark gray"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = .125, linetype = 2, color = "dark gray")) +
    labs(title = paste("Population density of", city, "and benchmark cities"),
         y = bquote('Population density, people per '~km^2),
         x = "Population") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .03))) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
    scale_color_manual(values = hues) +
    expand_limits(y = 0)

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "oxford-pop-density-scatter.png"), plot = density_plot, device = "png",
         width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  ggplot2:::print.ggplot(density_plot)

  density %>% arrange(-Density) %>% print_paged_df()
}
```

### Benchmark Cities Population (WorldPop Global 1)

```{r multi-city-pop-g1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-multi-city-pop-g1
#| results: asis

bm_data <- pop_longitude %>% filter(Group != city)
city_g1 <- pop_longitude %>% filter(Group == city & Source == "WorldPop Global 1")
pop_g1_bm <- bind_rows(city_g1, bm_data)

if (nrow(pop_g1_bm) > 0 && nrow(city_g1) > 0) {
  hues <- c("black", "dark grey") %>% setNames(c(city, "Benchmark"))

  multi_g1_plot <- ggplot(pop_g1_bm) +
    geom_line(aes(x = Year, y = Population, group = Location, color = Group)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = hues) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = .125, color = "dark gray"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = .125, linetype = 2, color = "dark gray"),
          axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
          legend.position = "none") +
    labs(title = paste("Population of", city, "and benchmark cities"),
         subtitle = "WorldPop Global 1 (1km, UN-adjusted, 2000–2020)", x = "") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA),
      labels = scales::label_comma(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
      expand = c(0,0)) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(min(pop_g1_bm$Year), max(pop_g1_bm$Year), 5),
      minor_breaks = seq(2000, 2035, 1), expand = c(0,0)) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = \(x) slice_max(x, order_by = Year, by = Location),
      aes(label = Location, x = max(pop_g1_bm$Year), y = Population, color = Group),
      hjust = 0, size = 2.5, xlim = c(max(pop_g1_bm$Year) + 0.25, NA), box.padding = 0.05,
      direction = "y", segment.linetype = "dotted", max.overlaps = 20, force_pull = 1) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(max(2000, min(pop_g1_bm$Year)), max(pop_g1_bm$Year) + 7))

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "benchmark-pop-g1.png"), device = "png",
         width = 5, height = 4.6, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  ggplot2:::print.ggplot(multi_g1_plot)

  # Find comparison year: mode year across locations, closest to current year
  current_year <- as.numeric(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))
  common_years <- pop_g1_bm %>% count(Year) %>% filter(n == max(n)) %>%
    mutate(dist = abs(Year - current_year)) %>% slice_min(dist, n = 1) %>% pull(Year)
  compare_year <- common_years[1]

  print_text(paste0("Population comparison (", compare_year, ")"))
  pop_g1_bm %>%
    group_by(Location) %>%
    slice_min(abs(Year - compare_year), n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(-Population) %>%
    select(Group, Location, Year, Population) %>%
    arrange(Group, Population) %>%
    print_paged_df()
}
```
